meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为代码仓库生成分层说明，记录结构、命令与约定，让 AI 助手快速上手
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 编程助手立刻看懂你的仓库结构。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI agents to grasp your repo layout without lengthy onboarding.

howto.what: 这个技能会在项目里生成一套分层的 AGENTS.md 文件:先测量仓库大小,再并行扫描代码,给目录打分,按规则在根目录和符合条件的子目录写入知识库文件,记录结构、命令、约定。
howto.when: 当仓库需要为 AI 助手记录结构、命令、约定时使用;或用户直接输入“/init-deep”命令时触发。

say.text: 用 /init-deep 给这个仓库初始化 AGENTS.md。
say.note: 启动后开始测量并生成分层文件。
会先读旧文件再全部删除并重新生成。
限制只扫描两层子目录。

howto.what_en: Generates a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base: sizes the repo, scans code in parallel, scores directories, and writes AGENTS.md files at the root and qualifying subdirectories to document structure, commands, and conventions.
howto.when_en: Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents, or when the user invokes the /init-deep command.

say_en.text: Run /init-deep to initialize AGENTS.md for this repo.
say_en.note: Starts measuring and generating the hierarchy.
Reads existing, deletes all, then regenerates fresh.
Limits scanning to two directory levels.
